metadata.title: Forge Qualification Lab — Empirical Scientific Benchmark Archive
metadata.methodology_notice: Strict separation between Empirical Facts (raw measurement data, unedited scorecards) and Analytical Interpretations (hypotheses, discussion).

experimental_hypotheses.H1_Latency_Scale: Deploying large parameter models (>70B / 236B) on high-bandwidth VRAM (192GB AMD Instinct MI300X via vLLM) yields a >50x latency reduction compared to sub-bit local CPU/GPU execution without degrading schema recall.
experimental_hypotheses.H2_Quantization_Formatting_Degradation: Sub-8-bit quantizations (Q4_K_M GGUF) introduce syntactic formatting wrappers (e.g. Markdown codeblocks) that choke raw JSON parsers, but can be deterministically rescued via a normalizer without altering core reasoning.

thomas_translator_standard_suite.description: Empirical first-pass and guardrailed results across 21 deterministic test fixtures per model.

aircraft_search_grid_qualification_suite.description: Multi-terrain Search and Rescue (SAR) evidence qualification benchmark across 4 ground-truth crash sites.
